trajectory.thought: The leader (median of all 19 models) is a seeded baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable. With only 3 validation windows and a trend-dominated series where the median already robustly handles the few very bad models, further tuning is unlikely to produce a real gain over noise.

action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.97) with weak seasonality (0.09) and moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.59). The median of the full pool is the natural robust combiner here: it is insensitive to the handful of very poor models (worst error 1626 vs. best 52) while still benefiting from the 12 independent error groups. The runner-up (trimmed_mean of 5 stable models) is not statistically distinguishable from the leader given only 3 validation windows, and the dataset card confirms median/trimmed_mean are the top strategies on this dataset. Accepting the robust full-pool median is the safest choice.
